notes: Send x-waldo-app-contract: controls=8 to receive memory_revision on view=day; a build below 8 never receives it.

memory_revision is a per-owner count that moves whenever the owner's memory changes (a claim written, edited, confirmed, dismissed or forgotten; a pattern or a link between patterns saved or removed), from chat or from anything else: the nightly pass, the welcome build, the console. Re-reading a claim does not move it.
It is a signal to refresh, not a version to compare across owners or to do arithmetic on: when it differs from the value the open screen was built from, re-read the constellation.
It carries no content, and it is not part of the day view's revision, so a memory change never makes a pending day action stale.
